install.description: Writes the report script and the cron entry. No-op when both are already in place.
install.title: Install package report

uninstall.description: Removes the cron entry and the report script. No-op when absent.
uninstall.title: Uninstall package report

update.description: Reconciles the report script and the cron entry to the module's state. Same behavior as install.
update.title: Update package report

verify.description: Read-only check that the report script is in place, passes sh -n and the cron entry references it. Exits non-zero when it does not.
verify.title: Verify package report

description: Installs a daily cron job that refreshes the apt lists and appends the list of upgradable packages to /var/log/nebula/pkg-report.log, so the operator sees what is waiting on each host. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: pkg-report
title: Package report
